summary.narrow: Ha Long Bay–Cat Ba — один из наиболее выразительных природных объектов региона; подходит для ландшафта, wildlife/outdoor-сюжета и маршрутного видео.

geo.nearest_place_name_raw: Ha Long / Cat Ba / Hai Phong

sections.text: Ha Long Bay–Cat Ba — один из наиболее выразительных природных объектов региона; подходит для ландшафта, wildlife/outdoor-сюжета и маршрутного видео.

fee.description: From 1 Jul 2026 Ha Long International Passenger Port passenger fee: VND 80,000 round trip / VND 40,000 one-way; this is separate from bay sightseeing/cruise charges.

hours.value: Ha Long Bay attractions have seasonal receiving hours. Typical major cave/island sites: summer (16 Apr–31 Oct) about 07:30–17:30; winter (1 Nov–15 Apr) about 07:30–17:00. Bay departures: summer from 05:00 with return by 20:00; winter from 05:30 with return by 19:00.

entry.closure_notes: Typhoon, fog, high wind and maritime safety orders can suspend cruises with little notice. New vessel-management rules were implemented in 2026.
entry.notes: Day/overnight cruise from regulated passenger ports such as Ha Long International Passenger Port or Tuan Chau; Cat Ba/Lan Ha routes have separate operators and inter-bay rules.

legs.notes: Day/overnight cruise from regulated passenger ports such as Ha Long International Passenger Port or Tuan Chau; Cat Ba/Lan Ha routes have separate operators and inter-bay rules. Cruise vessel/tour boat; port procedures and vessel departure declarations are regulated. Individual caves/islands are reached only on authorized cruise routes.

rules.permit_or_guide: Use licensed cruise/boat operator; itinerary must match authorized bay route.
rules.access_requirements: Проверить ступени, грунт, лодочные посадки и доступность на официальной странице; природные и археологические объекты часто не безбарьерны.

seasonality.best_period: Весна/осень; круизы зависят от погодных запретов.
seasonality.heat_rain_notes: Северный морской климат; зимой прохладно/туманно, летом тайфуны.
seasonality.site_specific_notes: Перед выездом смотреть фактический прогноз; для моря, гор, рек, пещер и вулканов оперативная погода важнее климатической нормы.

visual_recon.best_time: sunrise/sunset from permitted cruise route; mist can create strong atmospheric layers

restrictions: Drone use requires current aviation/local heritage permission; do not assume launch from cruise is allowed.

visual_recon.filming_restrictions: Cruise and cave operators can restrict tripods/drones; protected heritage rules apply.
